title: First post
text:
Each post is its own folder, so images and data can sit next to the .qmd that uses them. Copy blog/posts/2026-07-10-first-post/ and edit.
Math renders without doing anything: \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \rho / \varepsilon_0\).
Code cells execute at render time and the results get cached in _freeze/, so CI never needs your environment:

import numpy as np
np.linspace(0, 1, 5)

Delete the eval: false once you’ve committed _freeze/.

title: gabbro
text:
Try it
import gabbro as gb

shot = gb.read_segy("line-42.sgy")
gathers = shot.sort("cdp").nmo(velocity=gb.velocity.from_picks("picks.csv"))
stack = gathers.stack()
stack.plot()
The section at the top of this page is a synthetic gather: six dipping reflectors convolved with a 26 Hz Ricker wavelet, plotted variable-area. The script that made it lives in assets/make_hero.py.
